rules.label: More than one item
rules.reminder: Show one item per turn: one visual of that item and one short reply beside it. Put progress in the status line, and send the next item after the user answers this one.

rules.label: No picture
rules.reminder: Show the item as one visual first, a widget or a published page, holding that one item's facts. Then send one reply of one or two short sentences.

rules.label: Too many words
rules.reminder: Cut the reply to three short sentences or fewer. The visual carries the detail.

rules.label: No tap answer
rules.reminder: Ask each question as a decision card the user answers with a tap. Keep the question out of the reply text.

rules.label: Abbreviations
rules.reminder: Write each name in plain descriptive words. Spell out every abbreviation and drop tracker and item numbers. A pull request number stays only inside its link.

rules.label: Wall of text
rules.reminder: Put each point, and each step the reader takes, on its own line.
